raw_context: Twitter/X: 'Ang kabog ng performance niya, walang katalo!' — used to say someone or something is amazing/unbeatable
Twitter/X threads: 'SKL lang, may nakita akong bagay sa store' (Share Ko Lang — used to introduce a story or tea)
Twitter/X viral: after content creator Sesable's makeup video 'Sobrang Latina!' spread as a general hype/compliment phrase
Twitter/X: 'Nag-aura farming siya nang mag-post ng fit check' — deliberately creating moments to build a cool or impressive image
Filipino Twitter stan culture: 'Oomf ko 'yan, follow ko siya' — 'one of my followers', refers to a mutual or follower
Twitter/X: 'Naratio ka na naman' — when a reply gets more likes/retweets than the original tweet, implying the original was wrong or bad
Filipino Twitter: 'QRT mo na 'yan para mapansin' — 'quote retweet', used as a verb meaning to quote-tweet someone
Twitter/X: 'Pinog niya lahat sa red carpet, mogging everyone' — to outshine or outperform someone in appearance, skill, or presence
Twitter/X: 'Grabe, sobrang daming brain rot content sa FYP ko' — mental fog or degraded attention caused by excessive low-quality content consumption
Twitter/X: 'Touch grass ka muna, masyadong online' — telling someone to go outside and disconnect from the internet
Twitter/X: 'Huwag mo i-engage, rage bait lang 'yan' — content deliberately designed to provoke anger and drive viral engagement
Twitter/X and TikTok PH: 'Main character energy talaga ni ate' — the aura or attitude of someone who acts as if they are the protagonist of their own story
Twitter/X: 'Ate girl energy' — refers to a specific social archetype: relatable, down-to-earth, sisterly, girl-next-door type
Twitter/X: 'May bagong phone siya, naol' — abbreviated form of 'sana all', expressing light envy or wishing the same for oneself
Filipino Twitter KPop/stan culture: 'Mag-fancam kayo ng bias niyo' — a fan-edited video compilation or focused camera clip of an idol; used as verb and noun
Filipino stan Twitter: 'Twt lang, hindi totoo' — shorthand disclaimer meaning 'Twitter only' or 'this is just for Twitter, not real life'
Twitter/X: 'Kinansela na siya ng mga tao' — to publicly withdraw support from a person or brand, especially after controversy; cancel culture
Twitter/X viral meme: 'Marupok ka pag nag-text lang 'yung ex mo, babalik ka agad' — easily emotionally affected, especially in romance; 'fragile-hearted'
